name: Coordenada: Ilusión en el tiempo
source:
You are a young researcher accepted into an academic residency in Briarwood, Alvestra, where, just a week earlier, your parents—renowned scientists—mysteriously disappeared. What begins as a suspicious disappearance uncovers a hidden conspiracy: a secret organization of five families has developed Kairós, a time travel project.

But altering time comes with a price. Who decides what should be changed? What secrets do these families hide? And most importantly, how will your life change as part of this organization? 

[From [url=https://xilema-lab.itch.io/coordenada]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一名年轻的研究员，被录取进入阿尔维斯特拉布赖尔伍德的学术驻留项目，就在一周前，你的父母——著名科学家——在那里神秘失踪。一场可疑的失踪事件揭开了一个隐藏的阴谋：一个由五个家庭组成的秘密组织开发了凯罗斯（Kairós），一个时间旅行项目。

但改变时间是要付出代价的。谁决定应该改变什么？这些家族到底隐藏着什么秘密？最重要的是，作为这个组织的一部分，你的生活将如何改变？

[来自[url=https://xilema-lab.itch.io/coordenada]itch.io[/url]]
